expect.asks_about: Which person in the photo is the user: the bearded man on the left or the short-haired blonde woman on the right?

item.title: Choose The Right Headshot Subject

turns.text: Can you make me a square professional headshot from this?

item.tests: Clarifies the intended person in a two-person source before producing a single identity-preserving headshot.

answer_sheet.Which person: I'm the woman with short blonde hair on the right.
answer_sheet.Style and expression: Natural and professional; keep my smile.
answer_sheet.Platform and size: No particular platform; square, 640 × 640 is fine.

must_haves: The only person in the final portrait is the short-haired blonde woman from the right of two-friends.jpg.
Her face, short blonde hairstyle and smile remain recognisable from the source.
The man is entirely absent, including any partial face, shoulder or arm.
The beach setting and casual presentation are replaced with professional clothing and an unobtrusive backdrop.
The output is a square head-and-shoulders portrait with natural-looking lighting and no visible editing artifacts.

turns.text: Could you make me a professional headshot from this pic? I've been meaning to get a proper headshot sorted out for a while. The thing I nearly forgot to mention in the middle of all this is that I'd like it to be square. I'm just a little nervous about how it'll turn out, since I don't usually know what makes a good headshot.

dialog.agent:
Absolutely—I can make it square, with a clean background, soft lighting, and a professional head-and-shoulders crop while keeping you looking like yourself.

Which person are you: **the person on the left** or **the person on the right**?
dialog.user: I'm the woman with short blonde hair on the right. I'd like it to look natural and professional, and please keep my smile. I've been meaning to get a proper headshot sorted out for a while.

turns.agent:
I couldn’t generate the headshot because your Magic Hour account has insufficient credits. No image was created.

Your photo is a good starting point—your smile looks warm and approachable. The planned edit is a **square head-and-shoulders portrait**, keeping your blonde hair and smile, with soft lighting, a light gray background, and a navy blazer over an ivory blouse.

Once you’ve added credits, I can try again.

approvals.name: edit_image

style.prompt: Create a natural photorealistic professional headshot of ONLY the adult woman on the RIGHT in the supplied two-person beach photo. Preserve her exact identity, facial features, short blonde bob hairstyle, and her original warm tooth-showing smile. Remove the man entirely. Square composition, centered head-and-shoulders portrait at eye level, entire hair and head visible with comfortable space above head. Replace beach with a clean softly blurred light gray studio background. Dress her in an understated navy blazer over a simple ivory blouse, professional and modest. Soft flattering diffused studio lighting, natural skin texture and realistic coloring, minimal retouching. Warm approachable professional appearance. Do not change her age, face shape, smile, teeth, or hairstyle. No beauty filter, excessive skin smoothing, text or logos.
